description: Retrieval quality evaluation for CyberGuard AI hybrid RAG (Step 3). Each query lists the knowledge-base categories that a competent SOC analyst should consider relevant, plus expected sections where they are unambiguous.
metrics_notes: Recall@k = fraction of queries with at least one expected category among the top-k results. MRR uses the rank of the first result whose category is expected (max rank 5).
